name: com.amircollider.unitydocsnap
description:
Snap your whole Unity project into a clean, offline documentation set - for humans and AI alike.

Unity DocSnap walks every Scene (full Hierarchy, every Component, every serialized field, every reference) and every Asset folder (import settings, Material shader properties, Prefab contents, script metadata) and bakes it into a self-contained, offline HTML site with a Simple / Advanced view toggle, a project health report, a packages page and full-text search.

FREE (no key needed): the entire exporter - every Scene, every Component, every serialized field, the health report, the packages page, search, both visual skins and all three languages.

PLUS ($19.99, one-off): AI-ready summaries (summary/ and ai-bundle.md) plus the Changes page - what moved between two exports.

PRO ($49.99, one-off): everything in Plus, plus unlimited version history, incremental updates, verbatim file copies, whole-project .unitypackage backups, CI automation via DocSnapAPI, and a custom logo.

Editor-only: zero runtime cost, zero added build size, zero third-party dependencies.
